items.title: Hollow Harvest and Season 1 end November 1
items.body: The Halloween event, its pass and the Season 1 pass all run until November 1. Finish your tiers and claim your rewards before then.

items.title: Lanternfall 1.0 is out
items.body: 21 worlds with 21 bosses, 12 lanterns, a rank road to level 100 and Prestige. Thanks for playing.

items.title: Keep your progress safe
items.body: Add Lanternfall to your home screen, and back up your save any time with Save as file in Settings. On iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android: the menu, then Install app.

items.title: Your progress can follow you now
items.body: Turn on Online backup in Settings and sign in with Google, and your progress follows you to any device. Prefer to carry it yourself? Save as file and Import from file move it in a tap.

items.title: Lanternfall 1.2: Crossroads
items.body: Paths can cross over themselves. Every lantern gets a third upgrade path, but only two can be active, and each ascension is linked to a path. The Mint is now the Sapling, a support lantern that grows every wave, and all Mint skins carried over.

items.title: Lanternfall 2.0: The Simmering Moon
items.body: Season 2 is here: a 150-tier pass, three new lanterns, a cauldron to brew potions in, and eleven new worlds past the edge of the map. The Season 1 pass and Hollow Harvest have ended. Thanks for playing.
